name: erythroxy
description: JAX/GPU on small hardware — defense AND offense. Defense: beat OOM/systemd-oomd, VRAM-resident design (live in VRAM while the host thrashes), chunk/stream, XLA tuning. Offense: the memory hierarchy as a pipeline (generate on-the-fly in VRAM, never read disk in the loop), async data overlap, periodic checkpointing, batch-axis parallelism, and saturating every FLOP (GPU on gradients, everything else offloaded).
